// diagnostic

E0956

`{what}` isn't supported by the current evaluator yet

What

`{what}` isn't supported by the current evaluator yet

Why

The canonical TIR evaluator doesn't cover this construct yet

Fix

use a simpler form, or use `jet build` for the full evaluator

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0956: tests/ui/comptime_panic.stderr.

Error [E0956]: `require/panic stop` isn't supported by the current evaluator yet
  --> tests/ui/comptime_panic.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     assert((n > 100), "n must be over 100")
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: the canonical TIR evaluator doesn't cover this construct yet
 Fix: use a simpler form, or use `jet build` for the full evaluator
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0956

Error [E0107]: nothing named `@x` exists here
  --> tests/ui/comptime_panic.jet:8:20
    |
  8 | fn run() { print("{@x}") }
    |                    ^^
 Why: a name must be declared before it's used
 Fix: declare it first: `@x :: ...`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0107
